overview_description.description: NewsCatcher is the go-to solution for professionals needing reliable, accurate, and timely news data. In an era where businesses depend on AI and LLMs, quality data is critical to maintaining a competitive edge. NewsCatcher delivers clean, normalized, near-real-time news from over 70,000 global sources, covering 98% of each site, including hyper-local content. Our enriched data includes sentiment scores, named entity detection, and clustering, minimizing post-processing needs. We tailor automated news systems for specific sectors and regions, ensuring relevance and integration into existing workflows. With transparent data collection processes, we empower businesses to stay informed and ahead in their industry.

product.name: News API
product.description: An API providing access to cleaned, enriched, and structured news articles from over 90,000 global sources with advanced filtering and near real-time updates.

product.name: Custom News Data Solutions
product.description: Tailored news data integrations and pipelines designed to meet specific enterprise needs, including entity resolution, event intelligence, insights engine, and localized news.

product.name: News Datasets
product.description: Structured and enriched news article datasets covering various event types and topics, updated in near real-time for use in analytics and machine learning.

product.name: Events Intelligence API
product.description: An API that detects, clusters, and extracts structured event data from news articles to support market and public interest monitoring.

product.name: Local News API
product.description: An API delivering hyperlocal news coverage with city-level granularity across over 31,000 U.S. locations, enabling precise local insights.
